NewsArticle.Title: Dark Ages enters top 100 games
NewsArticle.Content: [Dark Ages](http://www.darkages.com/) appears in the top 100 games on [WorldCharts.com](http://www.worldcharts.nl/gcm-runners.html) Thank you for caring about your world. Support Dark Ages, the world that empowers and entertains roleplayers world-wide. [Click here](http://www.worldcharts.nl/gvote.html?add=[3390]) weekly to vote for Dark Ages. With your support, everything is possible.
